name: Steps
summary: Shows progress through a flow of steps, horizontal or vertical, with complete, current and upcoming states.
description: Use steps above a multi-step form or for an order status. Keep it to a handful of short labels; for a long history use a timeline.

classes.name: v-steps
classes.description: The list, on an <ol>. Markers number themselves.

classes.name: v-steps-vertical
classes.description: Markers in a column with the connector running down, room for a description.

classes.name: v-step
classes.description: One step, on an <li>. Upcoming unless marked otherwise.

classes.name: v-step-complete
classes.description: A finished step: filled marker with a drawn check, accent connector.

classes.name: v-step-desc
classes.description: A quieter line under the label, such as a date.

states.description: On the current step: accent ring and bold label.

a11y: Give the <ol> an aria-label such as Sign-up progress.
The check mark is drawn in CSS, so add a .v-sr-only "Completed: " to each finished label.
aria-current="step" tells screen readers which step is current.
